principles: Keep Glimmer's successful first flame as the emotional centre of the story.
Match the installed art's supervised stone fire circle, water, extinguisher, and magical lantern system.
Use short, concrete Level C sentences and model stopping when an adult gives a safety instruction.

pages.reason: Removes the missing performance sign and introduces the visible safety equipment.
pages.text: Everyone came to the Hollow Oak. Luna had made a safe fire circle. A bucket of water and an extinguisher stood nearby.

pages.reason: Places the audience outside the stone circle and establishes Luna's supervision.
pages.text: They sat outside the circle. Glimmer stood in the middle. "Ready?" asked Luna. Glimmer nodded.

pages.reason: Keeps the first-fire achievement small, steady, and visually aligned.
pages.text: Glimmer breathed in. Then Glimmer breathed out. A tiny orange flame appeared. Small. Steady. Real.

pages.reason: Shows the audience's reaction while making clear that the first flame has ended.
pages.text: Everyone gasped. Pip covered his mouth. Stone's eyes went wide. Luna watched closely. The flame went out.

pages.reason: Replaces an escalating unsupervised attempt with permission and containment.
pages.text: "May I try again?" asked Glimmer. Luna nodded. Glimmer made a longer flame. It stayed inside the stone circle.

pages.reason: Models stopping immediately when the supervising adult gives the signal.
pages.text: Glimmer grew excited. The flame stopped. "Pause," said Luna. Glimmer stopped and waited.

pages.reason: Makes the lantern lighting deliberate, small, and supervised rather than accidental.
pages.text: Luna placed a magic lantern in the circle. "One small flame," she said. Glimmer lit it carefully.

pages.reason: Clarifies that magic carries light through lamps rather than fire spreading through the forest.
pages.text: The lantern sent a golden spark to the next lamp. Lamp by lamp, safe magical light travelled along the paths.

pages.reason: Retains the illuminated-forest payoff without language that suggests wildfire.
pages.text: Moonwood glowed with gold. Every lamp. Every mushroom. Every glowing stone. The forest looked beautiful.

pages.reason: Keeps Glimmer's surprise and matches the group observing the lights.
pages.text: Everyone looked at the lights. Then everyone looked at Glimmer. "Did I do that?" asked Glimmer.

pages.reason: Credits Glimmer's careful action while explaining that the lantern system carried the light.
pages.text: Luna smiled. "You made one careful flame," she said. "The lanterns carried the light." Glimmer beamed.

pages.reason: Ends with pride, future supervised practice, and a warm joke appropriate to the new safety arc.
pages.text: "I did it," said Glimmer. "You did," said Pip. "Can I practise again?" "Another day, with Luna," said Pip. Everyone smiled.
